lemmas.statement: The exact positive-sign gradient shears have subtraction inverses and preserve the standard symplectic form by symmetric Hessian blocks.
The eight literal gradient-support rows produce A_g, B_g, and phase order C_g=B_g*A_g.
All four pure-versus-product selectors are strict on the displayed ratio cone for every integer g>=10.
The ordinary seed lies in the ratio cone, and all six target faces are preserved in the required strict or closed direction.
Base and later p and q carry inequalities preserve the phase-labelled exact recurrence.
Positive integer coefficients and characteristic zero prevent selected leading-form cancellation.
q_4 is the unique visible coordinate for n>=1 and gives the exact total-degree identity, with the tied n=0 case stated separately.
Ten principal-minor identities and determinant expansion give the displayed quartic, R_g(1), and scalar recurrence.
Positivity of C_g and visibility of the seed and e_4 observable give lambda_1(F_g)=rho(C_g).
For g congruent to 3 modulo 5, hand exclusion of roots and monic quadratic factors proves irreducibility and an infinite pairwise-distinct quartic Perron subfamily.
The support-kernel lemma explains removal of Paper 22's common unit sector but is neither novel nor sufficient for quartic growth.
The g=9 failure, citation depths, predecessor ownership, typography correction lock, anti-claims, and zero-science boundary are explicit.
